message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise‑complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are handled by the **Atlanta Police Department** and can be submitted in several ways: | Method | How to File | Contact | |--------|-------------|---------| | **Online 311 Portal** | Visit the City’s 311 website and select “Noise Complaint.” You’ll be prompted to enter details such as location, time, and description of the disturbance. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | **Phone (Non‑Emergency)** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000** and let the dispatcher record your complaint. | 404‑656‑4000 | | **In‑Person** | Go to the City Hall or a local police precinct and speak with an officer or clerk. | City Hall – 1000 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | **Mail** | Send a written complaint to:
City of Atlanta, Office of Noise Control
1000 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30303 | | ### What to Include - **Date & Time** of the disturbance - **Exact location** (address or intersection) - **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, barking dogs, construction) - **Duration** (how long it has been happening) - **Any prior attempts** to resolve the issue (e.g., talking to the neighbor) ### After Filing - The police will investigate and may issue a warning or citation if the noise violates city ordinances. - If the problem persists, you can follow up with the police or the City’s Office of Noise Control. Feel free to use any of these methods to report the noise issue. If you have more questions or need help filling out the online form, let me know!
